message: Huge fan of everything Whedon.  My wife and I have few vices, but one of them seems to center around us dropping huge coin to buy everything by Whedon on DVD and watching it repeatedly.  Firefly happens to be one of my all-time favorite series (which was quickly cancelled-Thanks FOX), and the follow-up movie Serenity did not disapoint.  Loved Dr. Horrible & will be spending the money to purchase my own copy.
